sn12.66:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kurūsu viharati kammāsadammaṃ nāma kurūnaṃ nigamo.
sn12.66:1.7: sammasatha no tumhe bhikkhave antarā sammasananti?
sn12.66:1.8: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn12.66:1.9: ahaṃ kho bhante, sammasāmi antaraṃ sammasanti.
sn12.66:1.10: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu sammasasi antarā sammasanti?
sn12.66:1.12: yathā so bhikkhu vyākāsi, na so bhikkhu bhagavato cittaṃ ārādhesi.
sn12.66:2.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn12.66:2.3: yaṃ bhagavā antarā sammasanaṃ bhāseyya. bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī”ti.
sn12.66:2.5: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
sn12.66:3.1: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammasamāno sammasati antarā sammasanaṃ.
sn12.66:3.2: yaṃ kho idaṃ anekavidhaṃ nānappakārakaṃ dukkhaṃ loke uppajjati jarāmaraṇaṃ.
sn12.66:3.3: idaṃ nu kho dukkhaṃ kinnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiñjātikaṃ kimpabhavaṃ, kismiṃ sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti, kismiṃ asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hotīti.
sn12.66:3.5: yaṃ kho idaṃ anekavidhaṃ nānappakārakaṃ dukkhaṃ loke uppajjati jarāmaraṇaṃ.
sn12.66:3.6: idaṃ kho dukkhaṃ upadhinidānaṃ upadhisamudayaṃ upadhijātikaṃ upadhipabhavaṃ, upadhismiṃ sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti, upadhismiṃ asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hotīti.
sn12.66:3.7: so jarāmaraṇañca pajānāti, jarāmaraṇasamudayañca pajānāti, jarāmaraṇanirodhañca pajānāti. yā ca jarāmaraṇanirodhasāruppagāminī paṭipadā, tañca pajānāti.
sn12.66:3.9: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu sabbaso sammā dukkhakkhayāya paṭipanno jarāmaraṇanirodhāya.
sn12.66:4.2: upadhi panāyaṃ kinnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiñjātiko kimpabhavo, kismiṃ sati upadhi hoti, kismiṃ asati upadhi na hotīti.
sn12.66:4.4: upadhi taṇhānidāno taṇhāsamudayo taṇhājātiko taṇhāpabhavo, taṇhāya sati upadhi hoti, taṇhāya asati upadhi na hotīti.
sn12.66:4.5: so upadhiñca pajānāti, upadhisamudayañca pajānāti, upadhinirodhañca pajānāti, yā ca upadhinirodhasāruppagāminī paṭipadā, tañca pajānāti.
sn12.66:4.7: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu sabbaso sammā dukkhakkhayāya paṭipanno upadhinirodhāya.
sn12.66:5.2: taṇhā panāyaṃ kattha uppajjamānā uppajjati, kattha nivisamānā nivisatīti.
sn12.66:5.4: yaṃ kho kiñci loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati.
sn12.66:5.6: cakkhuṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati.
sn12.66:5.11: mano loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati.
sn12.66:6.1: ye hi ke ci bhikkhave, atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, taṃ niccato addakkhuṃ, sukhato addakkhuṃ, attato addakkhuṃ, ārogyato addakkhuṃ, khemato addakkhuṃ,
sn12.66:6.3: ye taṇhaṃ vaḍḍhesuṃ, te upadhiṃ vaḍḍhesuṃ.
sn12.66:6.4: ye upadhiṃ vaḍḍhesuṃ, te dukkhaṃ vaḍḍhesuṃ.
sn12.66:6.5: ye dukkhaṃ vaḍḍhesuṃ, te na parimucciṃsu jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, na parimucciṃsu dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn12.66:7.1: yepi hi ke ci bhikkhave, anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, taṃ niccato dakkhinti, sukhato dakkhinti. attato dakkhinti, ārogyato dakkhinti, khemato dakkhinti.
sn12.66:7.5: ye dukkhaṃ vaḍḍhessanti jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi. na parimuccissanti dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn12.66:8.1: yepi hi keci bhikkhave, etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, taṃ niccato passanti sukhato passanti, attato passanti, ārogyato passanti, khemato passanti.
sn12.66:8.3: ye taṇhaṃ vaḍḍhenti, te upadhiṃ vaḍḍhenti.
sn12.66:8.4: ye upadhiṃ vaḍḍhenti, te dukkhaṃ vaḍḍhenti.
sn12.66:8.5: ye dukkhaṃ vaḍḍhenti, te na parimuccanti jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi. na parimuccanti dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn12.66:9.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, āpānīyakaṃso vaṇṇasampanno gandhasampanno rasasampanno.
sn12.66:9.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito.
sn12.66:9.5: “ayaṃ te ambho purisa, āpānīyakaṃso vaṇṇasampanno gandhasampanno rasasampanno,
sn12.66:9.8: pivato hi kho taṃ chādissati vaṇṇenapi gandhenapi rasenapi. pītvā ca pana tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchasi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkha”nti.
sn12.66:9.9: so taṃ pānīyakaṃsaṃ sahasā appaṭisaṅkhā piveyya, na paṭinissajjeyya.
sn12.66:9.10: so tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya, maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
sn12.66:9.11: evameva kho bhikkhave, ye hi ke ci atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, taṃ niccato addakkhuṃ, sukhato addakkhuṃ, attato addakkhuṃ, ārogyato addakkhuṃ, khemato addakkhuṃ. te taṇhaṃ vaḍḍhesuṃ. ye taṇhaṃ …pe… ye dukkhaṃ vaḍḍhesuṃ. te na parimucciṃsu jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi. na parimucciṃsu dukkhasmāti vadāmi. ye hi ke ci bhikkhave,
sn12.66:9.12: anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, taṃ niccato dakkhinti, sukhato …pe… attato …pe… ārogyato …pe… khemato dakkhinti, te taṇhaṃ vaḍḍhessanti. ye taṇhaṃ …pe… ye dukkhaṃ vaḍḍhessanti. te …pe… na parimuccissanti dukkhasmāti vadāmi. ye hi ke ci bhikkhave,
sn12.66:9.13: etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, taṃ niccato passanti, sukhato passanti, attato passanti, ārogyato passanti, khemato passanti. te taṇhaṃ vaḍḍhenti.
sn12.66:9.16: te na parimuccanti jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi. na parimuccanti dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn12.66:10.1: ye ca kho ke ci bhikkhave, atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, taṃ aniccato addakkhuṃ, dukkhato addakkhuṃ, anattato addakkhuṃ, rogato addakkhuṃ, bhayato addakkhuṃ.
sn12.66:10.3: ye taṇhaṃ pajahiṃsu, te upadhiṃ pajahiṃsu.
sn12.66:10.4: ye upadhiṃ pajahiṃsu, te dukkhaṃ pajahiṃsu.
sn12.66:10.5: ye dukkhaṃ pajahiṃsu, te parimucciṃsu jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi. parimucciṃsu dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn12.66:11.1: yepi hi ke ci bhikkhave, anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, taṃ aniccato dakkhinti, dukkhato dakkhinti, anattato dakkhinti, rogato dakkhinti, bhayato dakkhinti.
sn12.66:12.1: yepi hi ke ci bhikkhave, etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, taṃ aniccato passanti, dukkhato passanti, anattato passanti, rogato passanti, bhayato passanti.
sn12.66:12.3: ye taṇhaṃ pajahanti, te upadhiṃ pajahanti.
sn12.66:12.4: ye upadhiṃ pajahanti, te dukkhaṃ pajahanti.
sn12.66:12.5: ye dukkhaṃ pajahanti, te parimuccanti jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, parimuccanti dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn12.66:13.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, āpānīyakaṃso vaṇṇasampanno gandhasampanno rasasampanno,
sn12.66:13.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito.
sn12.66:13.5: “ayaṃ te ambho purisa, āpānīyakaṃso vaṇṇasampanno gandhasampanno rasasampanno,
sn12.66:13.8: pivato hi kho taṃ chādissati vaṇṇenapi gandhenapi rasenapi. pītvā ca pana tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchasi, maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkha”nti.
sn12.66:13.9: atha kho bhikkhave, tassa purisassa evamassa:
sn12.66:13.10: “sakkā kho me ayaṃ surāpipāsitā pānīyena vā vinetuṃ, dadhimaṇḍakena vā vinetuṃ, matthaloṇikāya vā vinetuṃ, loṇasovīrakena vā vinetuṃ. na tvevāhaṃ taṃ piveyyaṃ yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā”ti.
sn12.66:13.11: so taṃ āpānīyakaṃsaṃ paṭisaṅkhā na piveyya, paṭinissajjeyya.
sn12.66:13.12: so tatonidānaṃ na maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya, maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
sn12.66:13.13: evameva kho bhikkhave, ye hi keci atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, taṃ aniccato addakkhuṃ, dukkhato addakkhuṃ, anattato addakkhuṃ, rogato addakkhuṃ, bhayato addakkhuṃ.
sn12.66:13.15: ye taṇhaṃ pajahiṃsu. te upadhiṃ pajahiṃsu.
sn12.66:13.16: ye upadhiṃ pajahiṃsu, te dukkhaṃ pajahiṃsu.
sn12.66:13.17: ye dukkhaṃ pajahiṃsu, te parimucciṃsu jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi parimucciṃsu dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn12.66:14.1: yepi hi ke ci bhikkhave, anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, taṃ aniccato dakkhinti …pe… te parimuccissanti jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, parimuccissanti dukkhasmāti vadāmi. yepi hi keci bhikkhave,
sn12.66:14.2: etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, taṃ aniccato passanti, dukkhato passanti, anattato passanti, rogato passanti, bhayato passanti.
sn12.66:14.4: ye taṇhaṃ pajahanti, te upadhiṃ pajahanti.
sn12.66:14.5: ye upadhiṃ pajahanti, te dukkhaṃ pajahanti.
sn12.66:14.6: ye dukkhaṃ pajahanti, te parimuccanti jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi parimuccanti dukkhasmāti vadāmīti.
